title: Imperial Palace Merge
description: Merge charming court characters from humble palace maid all the way to Empress—collect royal tribute coins and unlock gorgeous ancient costumes.
controls: Tap to summon attendants and drag two matching ranks together to merge and advance up the imperial hierarchy.

zh-CN.title: 宫廷合成晋升记
zh-CN.description: 国风古韵爆款宫廷合成：拖拽相同古风角色一路合体晋升，从秀女宫女一步步封后掌权，解锁绝美华服图鉴！
zh-CN.controls: 点击召唤角色并将两个同品级人物拖到一起合成晋升，解锁更高位份与宫廷华服。
